scope: Illustrative delayed-heating calculation for a fixed dust distribution; not target spectra, measured lags or a population-power forecast. Panels B and C use make_fig2_diagnostics.py; the target-history forecast uses the same grain model with recorded illumination histories.
presentation: A: cartoons of equal current power with different histories. B: fixed-distribution spectrum divided by equilibrium at the current power at two event ages. C: log10 ratio of 8-13 um luminosity to equilibrium against event age for four step amplitudes. D: MRS PSF against exponential hosts of fixed physical size.

panel_a.cartoons: Same central-engine brightness, hot inner rim, outer dust geometry and clump count; outer dust brightness alone differs to depict delayed illumination. Step histories are qualitative; the dot marks the observation.

panel_b.model: make_fig2_diagnostics.spectra(ratio, age)[0] (fixed distribution) divided by the same at age 1e5 (equilibrium at the new luminosity)
panel_b.ordinate: Fnu divided by the equilibrium Fnu at the current power; unity is equilibrium.
panel_b.shading: Light: common nominal rest-frame MRS coverage for the sample. Dark: the 8-13 um diagnostic band. Gold dotted: 9.7 and 18 um.
panel_b.assumptions: Optically thin isotropic shells, dM/dlnr proportional to r to 100 initial silicate inner radii, 0.1 um silicate/graphite grains, uniform echo delays on [0, 2r/c]. Amplitudes are illustrative.

panel_c.quantity: log10 of the 8-13 um luminosity of the delayed fixed-distribution spectrum over its equilibrium value at the current power
panel_c.age_units: Initial silicate inner-radius light-crossing times; the conversion to years depends on each target luminosity and is not drawn.

panel_d.host_profile: Exponential, I proportional to exp(-1.678 r/r_e), peak-normalised; half-light radius 3 kpc proper
panel_d.field: MIRI MRS channel 2 field of view 4.0 x 4.8 arcsec (JDox); dashed lines at ±2.0 arcsec
panel_d.meaning: Shows the angular contrast between an unresolved nucleus and a typical host, not a measured MRS PSF or resolved torus imaging.

limitations: Fixed-distribution model only; Figure 3 addresses dust evolution.
Amplitudes depend on the assumed radial dust distribution and grain mix; they are not target predictions.
Ages are in model units; the light-year scale of R_in varies across the sample.
Long-wavelength response may average over epochs before the observed light curves.
